$comment: CONFORMANCE FIXTURE for the file-roadmap adapter (spec 11, ADR-015). Every id here is synthetic and names the STATE it demonstrates. This file is not any repository's roadmap and must never be bound as one: it lived at .repo-governor/roadmap.json, acquired real gate items, and became this project's roadmap of record while GitHub tracked the same work -- the exact failure section 54 names. See ADR-022.

THIN-1.title: Work item with no non-goals or acceptance conditions
THIN-1.required_outcome: Deliberately underspecified: fixture for issue #2 (envelope thinness).

CANCELLED-1.title: Feature whose authority was withdrawn after execution began

decision_history.reversal_condition: none — do not resurrect without new admission

CANCELLED-1.$comment: Fixture for spec 38: roadmap CANCELLED while an execution root may still say READY. Expected disposition AUTHORITY_WITHDRAWN.

BADAUTH-1.title: Item with an authority value outside the closed vocabulary
BADAUTH-1.$comment: Fixture: must yield MALFORMED_SOURCE, never be silently coerced.

ADMITTED-1.title: Admitted to the roadmap but not cleared to execute
ADMITTED-1.$comment: INV-002 fixture: admission is not authorization.

NOAUTH-1.title: Work item with no authority field at all
NOAUTH-1.$comment: Fixture: must yield a BLOCKING unknown, never EXECUTE.

DONE-1.title: Work that is finished
DONE-1.$comment: INV-009 fixture: completed work must not read as authorized-to-execute.

AUTHORIZED-1.title: Admitted and cleared to execute
AUTHORIZED-1.required_outcome: The AUTHORIZED branch of INV-002 is exercised end to end.
AUTHORIZED-1.$comment: The AUTHORIZED fixture. Named for the state it demonstrates, not for a work item -- an id shared with real work is how this file became a second roadmap (ADR-022).
